messages:
Sam L: Quick postmortem follow-up: we need owners for the three action items from the DB failover incident. Goal: assign tickets, set due dates, and capture RACI + handoff steps here.

Tara V: I can own the failover reconcile fix (root cause: timeout during leader transfer). Will open a Jira and add tests.

Ben K: I'll take the runbook updates and the rollback playbook. I'll also schedule a runbook walkthrough with oncall.

SRE Ops: We'll handle alerts tuning and the monitoring dashboard changes. Create INF-4020 for the dashboard work and link to the postmortem.

Sam L: Proposed ticket mapping: INF-4018 = reconcile fix (Tara), INF-4019 = runbook + drills (Ben), INF-4020 = alerts + dashboard (SRE Ops). ETA for initial PRs: one week.

Tara V: INF-4018 created: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INF-4018. Acceptance: reconcile completes within 30s under 2x traffic; add unit + integration tests. ETA 2026-04-02. R: Tara, A: Sam, C: Ben/QA, I: Support.

Ben K: INF-4019 created: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INF-4019. Runbook checklist attached. I will host the walkthrough next Tue and post the recording.

SRE Ops: INF-4020 created and added to alerting board. Will propose new thresholds and reduced noise rules. Target 2026-04-06.

QA Lead: QA will own smoke validation after PRs land. Please tag QA on the ticket and include test commands.

Sam L: Handoff plan: after Tara's PR merges, Ben will run the staged canary and QA will run smoke. SRE Ops will monitor metrics for 48h before closure.

Tara V: Noted. I'll include a handoff checklist in INF-4018 describing what to validate and how to revert.

Ben K: Calendar note  I'll add canary windows and invite @eng-oncall. Avoid week-of infra maintenance windows per SRE Ops request.

SRE Ops: Reminder: add RACI blocks to each ticket using the template: R = owner, A = Sam (SRE lead), C = platform/QA, I = product/support.

Sam L: Also adding a recurring quarterly audit ticket (INF-4100) to run the failover smoke suite and detect regressions. Assigned to SRE Ops.

deploy-bot: Automated note  postmortem doc updated with incident timeline and links to the three new Jira tickets.

Sam L: Thanks everyone. Please update the remediation tracker sheet and close loops as work completes. If blockers appear, flag them here.

Ben K: Will do. Closing this thread after the walkthough is scheduled. :thumbsup:
